tools.name: check_file
tools.description: Reports which parts of a file are undocumented or have drifted out of sync with their documentation. Call this before documenting new code, to see what's already covered and what isn't.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

relativePath.description: Path to the file, relative to repoPath, forward-slash separated.

tools.name: find_record_for_selection
tools.description: Returns the existing documentation record that exactly matches the given selection, or null if that exact selection isn't documented yet. Use this before document_selection to check whether something is already covered, since writing a duplicate record is rejected.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

relativePath.description: Path to the file, relative to repoPath, forward-slash separated.

start.description: Start byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

end.description: End byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

tools.name: find_stale_record_for_selection
tools.description: Returns the stale (partially drifted) documentation record whose surviving anchors overlap the given selection, or null if none does. Use this to find what update_drifted_doc should replace.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

relativePath.description: Path to the file, relative to repoPath, forward-slash separated.

start.description: Start byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

end.description: End byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Returns every archived record for a repository -- documentation whose original code was deleted, kept instead of lost. Use this to find prior writing that could be reused via attach_archived_record.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

tools.name: document_selection
tools.description: Writes new documentation for an exact code selection. Fails if that exact selection is already documented (use find_record_for_selection first to check, or edit_doc_text to change existing text).

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

relativePath.description: Path to the file, relative to repoPath, forward-slash separated.

start.description: Start byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

end.description: End byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

docText.description: The documentation text to store, written in Markdown.

tools.name: attach_archived_record
tools.description: Reuses a previously archived documentation record by attaching it to a new, currently-undocumented code selection, removing it from the archive in the same step.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

archiveId.description: An archived record's id, as returned by search_archive.

relativePath.description: Path to the file, relative to repoPath, forward-slash separated.

start.description: Start byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

end.description: End byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

tools.name: update_drifted_doc
tools.description: Replaces a stale documentation record with a fresh one for the code's current form. Permanently discards the old record's text unless you pass the same text back.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

relativePath.description: Path to the file, relative to repoPath, forward-slash separated.

oldRecordId.description: A documentation record's id, as returned by document_selection, check_file, or find_record_for_selection.

start.description: Start byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

end.description: End byte offset of the code selection within the file's current text.

docText.description: The documentation text to store, written in Markdown.

tools.name: edit_doc_text
tools.description: Overwrites an existing record's documentation text in place, without touching what code it's attached to.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

relativePath.description: Path to the file, relative to repoPath, forward-slash separated.

recordId.description: A documentation record's id, as returned by document_selection, check_file, or find_record_for_selection.

newText.description: The documentation text to store, written in Markdown.

tools.name: delete_record
tools.description: Permanently deletes a documentation record. This cannot be undone and does not archive the text.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

relativePath.description: Path to the file, relative to repoPath, forward-slash separated.

recordId.description: A documentation record's id, as returned by document_selection, check_file, or find_record_for_selection.

tools.name: discard_archived_record
tools.description: Permanently removes a record from the archive. This cannot be undone.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root (the folder containing .rapid-docs/).

archiveId.description: An archived record's id, as returned by search_archive.
